item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `history: dspy.History` and populates `history.messages` with prior `{question, answer}` records matching the signature."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `DummyLM`, configures `dspy.ChatAdapter()`, and makes a real `Predict` call whose rendered `messages` are taken from `lm.history`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"The assertions inspect separate prior `user` messages for each history entry, showing history is expanded per turn rather than dumped as one blob."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Checks separate prior `assistant` messages for each history record, confirming alternating user/assistant pairs."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the six-message layout with history pairs before the final current-turn user message, consistent with system-first ordering."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Includes explicit assertions on message count, roles, contents, and the dummy return value `Rome`."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
